label: fix 1: practice
result:
Every one of the 17 skeptic issues is now fixed in `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/spec/v2-upgrades/practice.md`. Before I started, the file was unchanged since the pause commit, so an earlier fixer had edited nothing and I had nothing to undo. Nothing is committed.

- **Difficulty and levels (P11), scorecard #8, #9, #17:**
  - A new `cb-index` task saves College Board's Question Bank listing (ID, skill, tier, 1–7 score band; no question content) into `material/cb_index.json`.
  - Those bands set each type's starting rating, so all seven levels have types on day one.
  - `skill_ratings` rows start from a probe or the diagnostic, otherwise from `learners.current` via `1100 + 1.2 × (score − 530)`. A 700 student starts at 1304.
  - Cold start: until a skill has 8 clean answers or a level check, For me serves the test's 7/8/7 tier mix, so a new student never gets a run of Easy.
  - Acceptance 1, 3 and 7–9 cover this, and override #46 now holds.
- **Timer (P16), #14, #23:** the clock starts as the sum of each planned slot's budget (`cfg.plan`). Every added question adds its own time ("+1:05 for the repair"), and a tier change moves it by the difference. A voided question gives its time back. `clock_log` records each change. Test pace in R34 changed to match.
- **Sure, Unsure, Guess (P7), #39:** the button is now Check · Sure · Unsure · Guess. Enter, a plain Check or a second tap files `conf:'auto'`, which the server stores as unrated. It counts as Sure only for students who tag Unsure or Guess on at least 10% of their last 50 first answers. Every rule about confident misses reads only an explicit Sure, and the calibration card gets an Unrated bar.
- **Explanations (P1, P2), #22:** `steps_coverage.py` fails below 50% of test weight, and P1 isn't done until it passes. Every template without steps gets a checked Method paragraph of at least 40 words. The hint button counts only the rungs an item really has ("Hint · 1 of 2").
- **Desmos (P3), #27:** the launch floor is all 175 templates in the six Desmos-heavy families, plus a production key. Until both are in, P3 stays behind the `DESMOS_WAY` flag and the row stays at parity.
- **Reference (P24), #28:** all 386 templates get an explicit list of the formulas they use (or none). The fallback to a skill heading is gone.
- **Official questions (P13), #2:** any College Board Math ID now resolves through the listing index to twins at its skill and tier. Each skill row links to College Board's bank with a "Paste what you missed there" field. I removed the old rejection of detecting Reading & Writing IDs, since the index now identifies them.
- **Bluebook exclude (P13), #7:** every pool rejects a question matching an official item's exact numbers or wording, and the Repeats line says "No practice question copies a College Board question." `tools/pinned_check.py` checks it.
- **Reading & Writing tab (P15), #4:** it lists the 10 R&W skills, each linked to College Board's bank, plus a Log it form that saves R&W misses (`subject 'rw'`) for Review and the future R&W bank. The skeptic said 8 skills; College Board lists 10. This row stays below TopTierPrep until the R&W bank exists.
- **Clean redo (P19), #25:** Retake and Rematch get a "Start clean" checkbox (on for Retake) that hides the student's highlights, notes, strikes and rules until Finish, keeping them on the server. v2 acceptance #17 is amended to match.
- **Study aids in test-like settings, #32:** the rule tip, the underline, the slip line and "Check anyway?" are left out of the payload in tests, the Daily Challenge, contests, end mode before Finish and Test-like mode, so they never reach the page. A new `type_rules` pref turns the rule tip off.
- **Next question (P23), #40:** the next question sent with the verdict is held in `cfg.pending` and only counts once it is shown. Adding questions, jumping, skipping, the final round or Exit discards it.
- **Keys, #40:** in the question runner, save moves to `Z` and Details to `X`, so `A–D` only choose. The same clash exists in the review player, so its save moves to `Z` too; that needs its owner to agree.
- **Vocab review (P12), #47:** a "Mix in due SAT words" setting puts due Words reviews into the set at breaks. They're filed to the Words schedule and kept out of all Math numbers.
- **Question types, #6:** every question type shows when a skill is opened, under sticky sub-headers with a count and select-all. The "Show all" line is deleted.
- **Marked and Saved, #11, #18:** they are now separate "Questions from" rows, each with Exactly / Fresh twins, plus presets and a Saved header link. The old Marked checkbox is removed.
- **Subject-aware:** section size, tier budgets, builder prefs (`prefs.practice[subject]`), `POST /api/drill`, set state and deep links all carry the subject. The fixed 95-second pace in the set state is replaced.
- **Classes (decision 5):** row #44 is now "Out of scope". Sharing and print wording no longer mentions classmates, teachers, tutors or groups. The share sheet now links Compete's invite-code private contests for friends who want to race. The file never referred to Compete's class-based groups, so there was nothing there to replace.
- **Supporting edits:**
  - Scorecard rows 2, 4, 6–9, 11, 14, 18, 22, 23, 25, 27, 28, 32, 39, 40, 44 and 47 were rewritten to match.
  - The §3.1 overrides, the §3.2 rows (R5, R6, R21 added; R9, R33, R34 and a batch of others updated) and the Rejected list were updated.
  - Three open questions were added: capturing College Board's listing, the 10% threshold, and the default difficulty. Open question 15 (the Desmos key) is closed as a launch requirement.
